# AEM Code Analyser 1.0.7

<p class="muted">Released 2026-11-16 · <a href="../">All release notes</a> · <a href="https://github.com/RohithV16/aem-code-analyser/releases/tag/v1.0.7" rel="noopener">GitHub release</a></p>

> **Upgrading?** A rule added in a release can fail a gate that passed on the previous
> version. Run this version once on a branch (`aem-analyser . --no-html`) before bumping CI,
> and accept existing findings with `--update-baseline` when the change is deliberate.

## Added
{: #added}

- Release assets include `aem-analyser-core` and `aem-analyser-maven-plugin` (previously only the
  shaded CLI jar), with `SHA256SUMS.txt` covering every attached file.
- Release notes lead with the token-free consumption route; the GitHub Packages route states its
  `read:packages` requirement.
